decision: opened the JIT audit on the userspace-jit commit
why: the task names that commit as the review baseline

decision: ran the existing JIT tests before edits
why: a later failure has to be separable from the starting tree
evidence: cargo test in jit/, 5 unit tests and 14 exec tests

decision: reject a bad lddw second word, a branch into that word, an unknown ALU opcode, and a BPF-to-BPF call
why: those inputs used to be accepted or could panic

decision: helper calls use the ilp32 dispatcher shape and link refuses a zero or missing address
why: the firmware function is helper_dispatcher(idx, a1..a5), not the Linux RV32 pair calling convention

decision: select xdp or xdp1 instead of the empty .text section
why: Clang marks an empty .text executable, so the first pass compiled zero instructions

decision: lower half and word memory ops as bytes
why: case_mark stored a u32 at packet offset 0x1e and the RV interpreter rejected the misaligned sw
flash_xdp only builds a named AOT profile, and bsort is larger than the firmware slot

decision: both engines faulting is recorded as inconclusive, not pass
why: the two interpreters share one memory limit, so a shared bound makes them fault together; calling that pass hides a register or memory disagreement

decision: check_packet writes a MAP1 descriptor per map and watches its storage
why: the CLI path never wrote one, so a helper lookup always missed and the map path was never compared
result: xdp_drop and firewall still r0 0x2, now with a writable map

why: the firmware contract has it at 0x4038_0000; 0x4038_1000 came from an encoder test fixture
result: open on the board: the address is still untested there

decision: patch_lddw checks the unlinked lui/addi shape before swapping in the address
why: the ABI note promised that a half-written relocation is not executable, but only the call path checked anything

decision: kept ALU END imm=64 and fixed the reference instead
why: RFC 9669 section 4.2 defines the 64-bit swap for the ALU class, and bitswap lowers to be64; the reference was truncating to 32 bits

decision: check-xdp.sh finds PREVAIL by itself and an inconclusive run is not a pass
why: a reviewer running the script as written hit the empty submodule directory
result: report.tsv reproduced without env overrides except CLANG
